explanation: The implementation uses WP_HTML_Tag_Processor to find and extract the TITLE element's text content. It creates a fragment parser, searches for the TITLE tag, and retrieves the text using get_modifiable_text(), which the documentation confirms automatically decodes character references like — to their proper characters. The function returns null only if the document cannot be parsed or has no TITLE element, while returning an empty string for an empty <title></title> tag.
